definition: Gross sell-in invoiced to distributors after on-invoice discount. Returns and credit notes are not deducted.
currency_rule: Local currency of the territory. No conversion.

definition: Gross invoiced sell-in minus returns credited, minus scheme and rebate credit notes (issued or accrued), minus any negative invoice lines.
currency_rule: USD at the monthly average rate of the transaction month. Weekends and gaps use the month's available days.

definition: Sum of the amount column in sell_in_orders.
Sales (M01) divided by target for the same territory and period.
Returns in the season divided by the season's gross sell-in.
formula: SUM(returns qty) / SUM(sell-in qty) for the season

definition: Returns credited in the period divided by gross sales in the same period.
Packs scanned by enrolled dealers divided by packs sold in to their distributors.
used_in: Loyalty reports. Coverage varies by region.

definition: Outstanding invoice value past its due date. 90+ days is critical.
currency_rule: USD at the snapshot month's average rate

definition: Placed at least one order in the last 12 months.
formula: COUNT(DISTINCT distributor_id) with order_date in last 365 days

definition: Has a non-zero outstanding balance or an invoice in the fiscal year.
